Q4 FY26 Performance Highlights


  ➢  Revenue:
           - INR Revenue of ₹ 706,980 Mn, up 5.4% QoQ | up 9.6% YoY
           - USD Revenue of $ 7,621 Mn, up 1.5% QoQ | up 2.1% YoY
           - Constant currency revenue up 1.2% QoQ | down 0.6% YoY

  ➢  Profit:
           - Operating Margin at 25.3%
           - Net Margin at 19.4%
           - Cash flow from operations at 106.7% of net profit

  ➢  Demand:

           -  Clients $100M+ up by 4 ; $50M+ up by 3 & $1M+ up by 14 QoQ

           -  Order book TCV at $12.0 Bn; North America TCV at $5.4 Bn; BFSI TCV at $3.9 Bn, Consumer Business TCV at $2.8 Bn

  ➢  People:
           - Closing headcount: 584,519
           - Voluntary LTM attrition at 13.7% in IT Services
